title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Assistance-Overlap Points on the Prompt-Pay Rate
content:
**Clause.** Assistance-overlap points are taken off the prompt-pay rate of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account while the account's hardship approval is in force — that is, while fewer than 12 whole calendar months (the hardship approval term of every payer class) have passed between the hardship approval date and the handling date.

| Hardship tier on the coverage record, approval in force | Points taken off the prompt-pay rate |
|---|---|
| full-100, partial-75 or partial-50 | 1 |
| partial-25 | 0.5 |
| no approval in force (tier none, or approval 12 or more whole months old) | 0 |

The points lower the prompt-pay rate itself, which is applied once to the charge.

**Cases (hypothetical).** Tier partial-25 approved 2 whole months ago: 0.5 points off. Tier partial-75 approved 12 whole months ago: no approval in force, none off.
